about_the_game:
Play as Enzo, a battle-hardened veteran turned elite federal agent, returning to Fortem Island to seek justice for his fallen brother-in-arms.
In a world overrun by crime syndicates, spies, and deadly conspiracies, every decision blurs the line between duty and vengeance.
Will you lead Enzo to uncover the truth—or be consumed by the storm of danger ahead?

Key Features

🎯 High-Speed Gunfights
Engage in thrilling firefights against intelligent, aggressive enemies. Adapt your tactics to a wide range of combat terrains and enemy styles.

🏃 Dynamic Movement
Climb, jump, and swing your way through dynamic environments, unlocking new routes and hidden secrets as you go.

🧩 Puzzles & Investigation
Solve environmental puzzles woven into the narrative, uncovering crucial clues that bring you closer to the truth.

🌍 Diverse Environments
Explore beautifully crafted locations—each offering unique challenges, secrets, and atmosphere that shape your journey.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core-i5 2550K 3.4GHz / AMD FX 8120 3.1 GHz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core-i7 3770 3.4GHz / AMD FX-8350 4.2GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Join Enzo on a gripping journey across Fortem Island to uncover the truth behind his comrade’s mysterious death. Experience an action-packed adventure filled with intense gunfights, close combat, fluid movement, and a detective story full of twists and revelations.
